summary: Jan Beṯ-Şawoce provides no edition translation. English in the input is machine translation and is not quoted as an edition translation. Added examples therefore have an empty translation field; meanings are assessed from the Turoyo.

The stem-II-looking m-pattern occurs in Preterit with -le and plural mšaǧaʕʕe, and in Infectum with third singular mšaǧəʕ, first singular mšaǧaʕno and plural mšaǧʕi-. No unobserved stems or boxes are proposed.
People and institutions have zero-marked object phrases; -li at Jan 4.I/424 marks the encouraged speaker. lašan d- and d- clauses describe the intended action without creating separate senses.

The pattern is compatible with an Arabic-contact encouragement verb, but the corpus alone does not establish when or how it was borrowed. This is a lexical verb, not a light-verb-plus-noun construction.
Jan 4.I/327 applies support to a publication in context; financial payment mentioned at /424 is an expected consequence, not a separate lexical payment sense.
